missions.name: Sizing Anomalies Across Suppliers
missions.query: Which styles have a size variance greater than 10% across all suppliers?

missions.name: Supplier Delayed Deliveries
missions.query: List all styles with a supplier lead time greater than 30 days and reorder point breaches within the last 60 days.

missions.name: Dead Stock by Supplier and Category
missions.query: Group by supplier and category, show the top 5 styles with the highest dead stock count (units not sold for 6 months or more).

missions.name: Price Variance Across Channels
missions.query: For each style, calculate the average price variance across all sales channels (retail vs online).

missions.name: Supplier Performance by Category
missions.query: For each category, show the top 3 suppliers with the highest on-time delivery rate and their corresponding lead times.

missions.name: Sales Event Channel Mix
missions.query: For each style, calculate the sales event channel mix (online vs retail) and show the top 5 styles with the highest online sales mix.

missions.name: Inventory Turns by Category
missions.query: Calculate the inventory turns (sales / average inventory) for each category and show the top 3 categories with the lowest inventory turns.

missions.name: Supplier Risk Assessment
missions.query: For each supplier, calculate a risk score based on lead time, on-time delivery rate, and country of origin, and show the top 5 suppliers with the highest risk scores.
